:::{#exm-mesh}
#### The mesh of a partition of $\lbrack 0, 1\rbrack$

For the partition of $[0, 1]$ in @exm-partition,
with widths $\change x_1 = 0.25$, $\change x_2 = 0.25$, and $\change x_3 = 0.5$,
the mesh is the largest of these widths, $\norm{\mathcal{P}} = 0.5$.

:::
